title: Junior Front-end Developer
description:
Lumen Health Tech builds appointment and messaging tools used by 200 GP surgeries. We are a fully remote team across the UK and are hiring a Junior Front-end Developer.

You will build features in our React and TypeScript web app, write tests for them, and work closely with our designer. Accessibility matters to us because many of our users are older patients.

Essential:
- React
- TypeScript
- Git and pull request workflows
- Writing automated tests

Desirable:
- Next.js
- Accessibility (WCAG)
- Working with a design system

Salary £32,000 to £36,000. Permanent, full-time, remote within the UK.

title: Graduate Software Engineer
description:
Fenwick Payments processes card payments for 5,000 small UK businesses. Our graduate engineers join a two-year programme, rotating through our web, API and data teams.

Essential:
- Programming experience in any language
- Interest in how payments work
- Clear written communication

Desirable:
- TypeScript or Node.js
- Experience with REST APIs

Salary £30,000. Permanent, full-time, remote within the UK.
